description: Docker container log rotation defaults (json-file driver caps) applied to all services in docker-compose.yml.

add.description: Per-container log file size cap (json-file driver).
Number of rotated log files kept per container.

notes: Log limits only apply when containers are recreated: run 'docker compose up -d' (not just restart) after the update. Also verify /etc/docker/daemon.json is valid JSON — older installers wrote a corrupt file; the current installer fixes it.
